description:
Upstream's `drainInput()` is called after disabling the keyboard protocol and before fully exiting. It reads and discards any remaining stdin bytes (especially Kitty key-release events) with a short timeout, preventing escape sequences from leaking to the parent shell — particularly important over slow SSH.

Our Terminal.terminate/2 just restores cooked mode and returns. Any in-flight bytes (especially key releases from Kitty mode) can leak.

Implement a drain phase in Terminal.terminate: after disabling keyboard protocol but before exiting raw mode, read and discard stdin for up to ~1s or until idle for ~50ms.

Ref: `terminal.ts` L228-260, `drainInput()`.
title: Terminal: drainInput on exit to prevent key leakage
